              ↳ reads state:annual

          - plan-price~/plan%3A%22business%22 [core/text@1.0.0] text="$29 per seat a month"

          - plan-limit~/plan%3A%22business%22 [core/text@1.0.0] text="Up to 200 seats"
          - plan-pick~/plan%3A%22business%22 [atelier/button@1.0.0] label="Choose this plan"
              ↳ writes click→state.plan
    - estimate [atelier/stat@1.0.0] label="Estimated cost" value="$75"
        ↳ reads state:annual, data:plans, state:plan, state:seats
    - faq [core/accordion@1.0.0] items=change|seats|yearly

props.description: Pick a plan, set the number of seats and see the cost. All prices on this page are illustrative.

items.title: Can I change plan later?
items.body: Yes. Pick another plan at any time; the estimate above updates to show the difference.

items.title: What counts as a seat?
items.body: One person who signs in. People who only read shared pages do not need a seat.

items.title: How does yearly billing work?
items.body: You pay for ten months and use twelve. The calculator applies this when you switch it on.
